verses.text: Have mercy upon me, O God, according to thy lovingkindness: According to the multitude of thy tender mercies blot out my transgressions.

segments.text: Have mercy upon me, O God, according to thy lovingkindness:
According to the multitude of thy tender mercies blot out my transgressions.

verses.text: Wash me thoroughly from mine iniquity, And cleanse me from my sin.

segments.text: Wash me thoroughly from mine iniquity,
And cleanse me from my sin.

verses.text: For I know my transgressions; And my sin is ever before me.

segments.text: For I know my transgressions;
And my sin is ever before me.

verses.text: Against thee, thee only, have I sinned, And done that which is evil in thy sight; That thou mayest be justified when thou speakest, And be clear when thou judgest.

segments.text: Against thee, thee only, have I sinned,
And done that which is evil in thy sight;
That thou mayest be justified when thou speakest,
And be clear when thou judgest.

verses.text: Behold, I was brought forth in iniquity; And in sin did my mother conceive me.

segments.text: Behold, I was brought forth in iniquity;
And in sin did my mother conceive me.

verses.text: Behold, thou desirest truth in the inward parts; And in the hidden part thou wilt make me to know wisdom.

segments.text: Behold, thou desirest truth in the inward parts;
And in the hidden part thou wilt make me to know wisdom.

verses.text: Purify me with hyssop, and I shall be clean: Wash me, and I shall be whiter than snow.

segments.text: Purify me with hyssop, and I shall be clean:
Wash me, and I shall be whiter than snow.

verses.text: Make me to hear joy and gladness, That the bones which thou hast broken may rejoice.

segments.text: Make me to hear joy and gladness,
That the bones which thou hast broken may rejoice.

verses.text: Hide thy face from my sins, And blot out all mine iniquities.

segments.text: Hide thy face from my sins,
And blot out all mine iniquities.

verses.text: Create in me a clean heart, O God; And renew a right spirit within me.

segments.text: Create in me a clean heart, O God;
And renew a right spirit within me.

verses.text: Cast me not away from thy presence; And take not thy holy Spirit from me.

segments.text: Cast me not away from thy presence;
And take not thy holy Spirit from me.

verses.text: Restore unto me the joy of thy salvation; And uphold me with a willing spirit.

segments.text: Restore unto me the joy of thy salvation;
And uphold me with a willing spirit.

verses.text: Then will I teach transgressors thy ways; And sinners shall be converted unto thee.

segments.text: Then will I teach transgressors thy ways;
And sinners shall be converted unto thee.

verses.text: Deliver me from bloodguiltiness, O God, thou God of my salvation; And my tongue shall sing aloud of thy righteousness.

segments.text: Deliver me from bloodguiltiness, O God, thou God of my salvation;
And
my tongue shall sing aloud of thy righteousness.

verses.text: O Lord, open thou my lips; And my mouth shall show forth thy praise.

segments.text: O Lord, open thou my lips;
And my mouth shall show forth thy praise.

verses.text: For thou delightest not in sacrifice; else would I give it: Thou hast no pleasure in burnt-offering.

segments.text: For thou delightest not in sacrifice; else would I give it:
Thou hast no pleasure in burnt-offering.

verses.text: The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit: A broken and a contrite heart, O God, thou wilt not despise.

segments.text: The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit:
A broken and a contrite heart, O God, thou wilt not despise.

verses.text: Do good in thy good pleasure unto Zion: Build thou the walls of Jerusalem.

segments.text: Do good in thy good pleasure unto Zion:
Build thou the walls of Jerusalem.

verses.text: Then wilt thou delight in the sacrifices of righteousness, In burnt-offering and whole burnt-offering: Then will they offer bullocks upon thine altar.

segments.text: Then wilt thou delight in the sacrifices of righteousness,
In burnt-offering and whole burnt-offering:
Then will they offer bullocks upon thine altar.

headings.text: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David; when Nathan the prophet came unto him, after he had gone in to Bath-sheba.
